title: Give every WMBT a one-line context clarifier

facts.note: WMBT artifacts can be found by file kind or path in the plan tree.
Fires when a WMBT is created or edited.
Task text mentions authoring or editing WMBTs.
Missing and multi-line can be checked mechanically. Whether the phrase is 'detailed situational' needs LLM judgement.

fires: The planner authors a new WMBT for a wagon.
The planner edits an existing WMBT's statement or context clarifier.
A WMBT has no context clarifier, or its clarifier spans more than one line.
doesNotFire: Editing acceptance test code that leaves the WMBT definition unchanged.
Editing wagon or plan docs that contain no WMBT entries.

given: A WMBT is being authored or edited
then: Declare a context clarifier: a detailed situational phrase, one line at most, that says when, where or how the WMBT applies. It is required.
prefer: One concrete line that names the situation the WMBT applies to (when, where or how), so the statement template can append it to the WMBT statement.
avoid: Leaving the context clarifier out or empty.
Clarifiers that span more than one line or turn into a paragraph.
Vague or generic qualifiers that do not narrow the situation.
why: The statement template appends the clarifier to the WMBT statement. Without a precise, situational one-line qualifier, the WMBT does not say when it applies.
evidence: Every WMBT in scope has a non-empty context_clarifier field.
The context_clarifier is a single line.
A reviewer confirms the phrase is situational (when/where/how) and not generic.
verifier_detail: Term id: context_clarifier, defined as 'a one-line situational qualifier'.
values.required = true: a missing or empty field is a finding.
values.pattern = 'detailed situational phrase, one line maximum': a newline inside the value is a finding. 'Detailed situational' is LLM-judged.
